notes: Reports whether a check for pending updates succeeds on this host, as ok or the error. Uses the host's own package tools directly, without mustra patch-list repository scoping and without a failing-since date.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: Reports whether a check for pending updates succeeds on this host, as ok or the error. Uses the host's own package tools directly, without mustra patch-list repository scoping and without a failing-since date.
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  out=$(apt-get -s upgrade 2>&1) && echo ok || echo "failed: $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 1)"
else
  dnf -q check-update >/dev/null 2>&1
  result=$?
  if [ "$result" -eq 0 ] || [ "$result" -eq 100 ]; then echo ok; else echo "failed: dnf exit $result"; fi
fi
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: Reports whether a check for pending updates succeeds on this host, as ok or the error. Uses the host's own package tools directly, without mustra patch-list repository scoping and without a failing-since date.
if softwareupdate -l >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ok; else echo "failed: softwareupdate exit $?"; fi
